title: Purple-to-blue or violet-to-pink gradients
question: Does a background, card, button, or active navigation item have a purple-to-blue or violet-to-pink gradient fill?

title: Gradient text in headings, numbers, or the logo
question: Is a heading, a number, or the logo filled with a color gradient instead of one solid color?

title: Colored glows around elements
question: Does a colored glow or a blurred colored halo surround a card, button, pill, icon, or emoji?

title: Color washes and blurred blobs behind content
question: Is there a radial color wash, a blurred color blob, an orb, a decorative grid, or a glowing line behind the content or the hero?

title: Neon or bright colored borders
question: Does a card, panel, or input have a neon or bright colored border?

title: Many near-identical tints of one hue for text
question: Is the text on the screen set in four or more near-identical tints of one hue, such as several lavenders?

title: Every element highlighted
question: Is the accent color or a highlight applied to so many elements on the screen that none of them stands out?

title: Glass cards with an inner highlight and a colored shadow
question: Is a card drawn as frosted glass, with a white inner highlight along its edge and a colored shadow?

title: Headings at weight 800 or 900
question: Is a heading set in an extra-bold or black weight?

title: Uppercase labels with wide tracking
question: Is a label or other short line, such as a section name, a stat title, or a line above the hero headline, set in uppercase with wide letterspacing?

title: Too many type sizes and weights on one screen
question: Does one screen show six or more different text sizes, or three or more weights?

title: Numbers in mixed formats
question: Do numbers of the same kind on one screen appear in mixed formats, such as an amount with cents next to an amount without, or one number padded with a leading zero next to others that are not?

title: Negative letter spacing on small text
question: Is small text, such as body text, captions, or labels, set so tight that its letters nearly touch?

title: Italic used for emphasis in interface text
question: Is italic used to emphasize words in labels, buttons, or other short interface text?

title: Emoji as icons or status
question: Is an emoji used as a navigation icon, as decoration on a label, or as a status marker?

title: Emoji inside pills and counts
question: Does a pill, badge, or count hold an emoji next to its number?

title: Icons in many sizes and colors
question: Do the icons on one screen come in several sizes, stroke weights, or colors?

title: Icons nudged off the column
question: In a list or menu, do the icons, or the text after them, visibly step out of one vertical column?

title: Sparkle icon as decoration
question: Is a sparkle icon or sparkle emoji used as decoration?

title: Glowing pills for counts and status
question: Is a count, plan name, keyboard shortcut, or status shown in a pill that glows?

title: PRO, New, and Beta badges everywhere
question: Do two or more elements on one screen carry a badge such as PRO, New, or Beta?

title: Every element a full pill
question: Are most of the controls and containers on the screen, such as fields, buttons, and cards, drawn with fully rounded pill ends?

title: Rainbow, glowing, or pill-shaped chart bars
question: Does a chart have bars in rainbow colors, glowing bars, bars with fully rounded ends, or day labels in uppercase?

title: Every chart in shades of the accent
question: Is every series of a chart or stacked bar drawn in a shade of the accent color, so that no series leads?

title: Sparklines on every stat card
question: Does every stat card in a row carry a sparkline, a tally, or a set of mini bars?

title: Equal cards side by side with the same chart
question: Does a dashboard row hold equal cards side by side, each with the same chart or the same layout?

title: Gradient logo tile with a sparkle
question: Is the logo a gradient tile with a sparkle, next to a wordmark filled with a gradient?

title: Logo mark as a glossy orb
question: Is the logo mark a glossy orb, a gradient ball, or a glowing dot?

title: Pill badge above the headline
question: Does a pill-shaped badge sit directly above the hero headline?

title: Hero stacked on one centered axis
question: Are the hero headline, its text, its buttons, and a picture below them all stacked on one centered axis?

title: Three or more buttons in the hero
question: Does the hero have three or more buttons, or chips or avatars stacked under its buttons?

title: Feature cards with an emoji and a bold title
question: Is there a row of feature cards, each with an emoji, a bold title, and one line of text?

title: Glossy 3D blob as the hero visual
question: Is the hero visual a glossy 3D blob, an orb, a liquid chrome shape, or a purple nebula?

title: Stock robots, glowing brains, and holograms
question: Does a visual on the page show a stock robot, a glowing brain, circuit lines, or a hologram?

title: Image that does not blend into the page
question: Does an image sit on the page as a box with a hard edge, on a background, such as a different black, that almost matches the page and does not?

title: A visual on every section
question: Does every section of the page have its own decorative visual?

title: Neutral dark template look
question: Is the page a near-black gray ground with white text in a stock neutral sans serif, the brand color on only one button, and no other color or element of its own?

title: Empty box or generic picture as the hero visual
question: Is the hero visual empty, a placeholder, or a stock picture?
